Using the Laplace transform identity,
\[
\int_0^\infty x^2 e^{-sx}\sin x\,dx = \frac{d^2}{ds^2}\left(\frac{1}{s^2+1}\right).
\]
At \(s=1\),
\[
\frac{d^2}{ds^2}\left(\frac{1}{s^2+1}\right)\bigg|_{s=1}
= \frac{2(3s^2-1)}{(s^2+1)^3}\bigg|_{s=1}
= \frac{2(3-1)}{8}
= \frac{1}{2}.
\]
